claims.text: Multiple baselines were tested, including a majority-class baseline and a human performance baseline.
The No-answer (NA) baseline was also evaluated, providing a lower bound on performance.
BERT-based baselines were implemented for evidence identification.
A word count baseline was used to assess lexical matching effectiveness.
